id.description: The identifier of the equipment instance.

name.description: The full name of the equipment instance.

type.description: The name of the equipment definition for this equipment instance. If this instance is not associated with an equipment definition, this value will be null.

self.description: A link to this equipment instance.

spacesUrl.description: A link to the spaces served by this equipment instance.

equipmentUrl.description: A link to the equipment served by this equipment instance.

equipmentDefinitionId.description: RELEASES: 15.0 and later\ The identifier of the equipment definition for this equipment instance. If this instance is not associated with an equipment definition, this value will be null.

upstreamEquipmentUrl.description: A link to the equipment that serves this equipment instance.

networkDevicesUrl.description: A link to the network devices that host this equipment instance.

pointsUrl.description: A link to the point mappings defined by this equipment instance.

hasUpstreamEquipment.description: RELEASES: 15.0 and later\ Indicates if the equipment instance has upstream equipment that serves it.

upstreamEquipment.description: RELEASES: 15.0 and later\ A collection of upstream equipment.

itemReference.description: The fully qualified reference of the object.

description.description: RELEASES: 15.0 and later\ The description of the equipment.

category.description: RELEASES: 15.0 and later\ The authorization category of the equipment The values for this property come from the `objectCategoryEnumSet` enumeration. Find the definition of `objectCategoryEnumSet` at the relative URL of `/schemas/enums/objectCategoryEnumSet`. **See also:** * [Get enumeration](#operation/getEnumerationAsJsonSchema) for more information on retrieving an enumeration.

subsystemCategory.description: RELEASES: 15.0 and later\ The system subtype of the equipment definition for this equipment instance. If this instance is not associated with an equipment definition, this value will be null. The values for this property come from the `subsystemCategoryEnumSet` enumeration. Find the definition of `subsystemCategoryEnumSet` at the relative URL of `/schemas/enums/subsystemCategoryEnumSet`. **See also:** * [Get enumeration](#operation/getEnumerationAsJsonSchema) for more information on retrieving an enumeration.

graphicAlias.description: RELEASES: 15.0 and later\ The alias to apply to the graphics associated with the equipment.
